title: Edit the sudo configuration
description: Edit the sudoers file safely to configure sudo rights

examples.description: Check the syntax of the sudoers file

notes: ALWAYS use visudo, NEVER edit /etc/sudoers directly. It checks the syntax before saving. Requires root (sudo).
